name: Pet Bond
description: Per-pet trust earned through care, training, and shared discovery. Bond is a persistent relationship value rather than another need meter: it does not decay while the player is away, it does not replace hunger or happiness, and it does not directly train stats. Repeated copies of one interaction receive diminishing credit so holding down the feed button cannot max a relationship. The component owns the bond curve and per-action repeat accounting; other systems consume bondTier to unlock behavior without each inventing a separate friendship number.

inputs.name: bondTiers
inputs.description: Ordered definitions: id, minimum bondScore, and optional display label. Thresholds are data so a short mobile game and a long-running collection game can use different relationship pacing.

inputs.name: interactionValues
inputs.description: Base bond awarded per accepted interaction type. The source system decides whether an interaction was valid; Pet Bond only values the resulting event.

inputs.name: fullCreditRepeatsPerDay
inputs.description: Number of same-type interactions per pet and day that receive full value before diminishing credit begins.

inputs.name: repeatCreditFloor
inputs.description: Minimum multiplier for repeated interactions. Above zero so continued play still counts, below one so varied care remains optimal.

outputs.name: bondScore
outputs.description: Lifetime bond for the equipped pet after repeat adjustment.

outputs.name: tierProgress
outputs.description: Normalized progress from the current tier to the next, clamped to [0, 1].

outputs.name: dailyInteractionCounts
outputs.description: Per-action repeat counts used for diminishing credit and UI explanations.

provenance: Added 2026-10-29 with the companion-led exploration components (a0f792a). Provenance written after the fact on 2026-10-29: it landed recording only "library-native". Nearest in a catalogue search: social.relationship_graph, which keeps decaying pairwise affinity between sims; this is one player-to-pet value that does not decay and is not a need meter. Library-native.
